title: Composed supervisory control: Off-delay ventilation fan -> Heartbeat watchdog timeout

outputs.name: A_RunOn
outputs.description: Subsystem A: Fan is in off-delay run-on

outputs.name: B_Healthy
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Monitor enabled and not timed out

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: Subsystem A: The runtime scan period is 100 ms.
Subsystem A: A_Demand is held TRUE for at least one scan before an off-delay test.
Subsystem A: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem B: The runtime scan period is 100 ms.
Subsystem B: B_Heartbeat is a pulse lasting no more than one scan.
Subsystem B: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Fan shall turn on without delay when A_Demand becomes TRUE and A_SafetyTrip is FALSE.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: After A_Demand becomes FALSE, A_Fan shall remain on for 300 ms unless A_SafetyTrip occurs.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_SafetyTrip shall turn A_Fan and A_RunOn off immediately.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_RunOn shall indicate the interval in which A_Demand is FALSE but the off-delay output remains TRUE.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: While monitoring, a B_Heartbeat shall restart the 400 ms B_Watchdog interval.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: Absence of B_Heartbeat for at least 400 ms shall latch B_TimedOut TRUE.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_MonitorEnable AND no_event(B_Heartbeat,4)) -> B_TimedOut))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Reset shall clear B_TimedOut only while B_MonitorEnable is FALSE.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Healthy shall equal B_MonitorEnable and not B_TimedOut.
A TRUE A_Fan shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
requirements.property: G(CrossReset -> (!CrossReady AND NOT B_TimedOut AND NOT B_Healthy)) AND G((NOT (SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady)) -> (NOT B_TimedOut AND NOT B_Healthy))

requirements.text: Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
